scope: Detection request identity, report freshness, cross-run reuse denial, and downstream invalidation planning

red_evidence.reason: the detector freshness and workflow invalidation modules were absent

assertions: request deduplication identity includes run, canonical text hash, canonicalization version, and request configuration hash
any canonical visible-text change invalidates detection and its review approval
presentation-only change can reuse detection but requires delivery review
cross-run reuse is denied by default
provider model-version and delivery-account changes remain explicit invalidation reasons

review.kind: separate primary-agent review because delegated review is disabled by session policy

live_blocker: Freshness behavior is verified locally, but provider-side model/version behavior has not been observed live.
